integrity: Analytical proof for all finite graphs and an asymptotic family, with finite exact witness and low-order computations as corroboration only. No independent audit claimed.
limitations: Canonical Euclidean metric only. The general fractional quadratic maximum can remain difficult to evaluate; the Ramsey example supplies a strict upper bound on radius, not its exact value. Previously known perfect-graph formula and classical Ramsey results are credited. Historical priority subject to inaccessible early sources.
title: Fractional antiblockers determine every Hansen inradius, with an unbounded failure of the clique law
